description: This file appears to be a PHP script involved in managing layout merge operations within the SuiteCRM Upgrade Wizard. It handles user selections for layout modules, performs rollback of merged layout files, formats layout data for display, and integrates with the Smarty templating engine to render user interface pages for confirming and managing layout merges during system upgrades.

methods.name: cleanMergeData
methods.description: Removes empty or irrelevant layout data entries to prepare data for user confirmation display.

methods.name: rollBackMergedModules
methods.description: Performs rollback of merged layout files for specified modules by restoring backed-up files.

methods.name: formatLayoutMergeDataForDisplay
methods.description: Formats raw layout merge data into a user-friendly structure for display in the UI, categorizing layout types by file names.
